purpose: Design for how the evaluator independently judges reviewer findings with meta-perspectives, and how the main body examines findings and evaluations, advances rounds and cleans up.
summary: Sequence S10-S20 covering evaluator, main body, round advance and review deletion
Class diagram of main body, evaluator, shared and body-only scripts, and JSON files
Evaluator definition: finding-first reading, five meta-perspectives reflected in evaluations, new findings via --new
Evaluation reason rules, severity from rule catalog, confidence and fix_confident semantics
Main body duties: examine evaluations rather than obey values, per-evaluation presentation, termination judgment, 4-round limit
Temporary consult measure: no agenda, state kept in conversation context, unhandled finding sources
evaluate_result.json structure, guarantees by script, and finding_id numbering shared with reviewer
Script specs: evaluator wrappers, append/seal for evaluations, resolve_review_path, count_actionable, advance_round, delete_review
Test design covering unit, contract, lint and integration cases, plus TBD on meta-perspective verification
tasks: Implementing evaluator.md and evaluator wrapper scripts
Implementing the review SKILL main body after evaluator launch
Implementing append_result, seal_result and resolve_review_path for evaluations
Implementing count_actionable, advance_round and delete_review scripts
Reviewing or revising the evaluator and meta-perspective design
Designing tests and lint for evaluator and review body definitions
Changing consult behavior during the temporary measure period
title: DES-083 evaluator の独立評価とメタ観点 設計書
